title: Protocol and Signal
author: Marguerite Yarrow
blurb: Emrys Almeida, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
